thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> LATENCY.P99_HIGH: EU-west inference cluster p99 latency 6.2s (SLO 1.5s) over 5m window. Triggered routes: text-generation, chat. Paging primary oncall.

oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it, jumping in. Starting triage.

sre-maya: I see a correlated spike in tokenizer sidecars and a burst of KV cache evictions around the same time. Heatmap shows hot-spike on model-ggml-13b-tokenizer pods.

eng-ryan: can confirm increased batch sizes from a specific customer burst (embed/streaming). Also noticed autoscaler for tokenizers is at max.

ops-jordan: Any customer-facing errors? statusbot: No 5xx spikes, only latency.

pm-lina: prepping standby customer note if service impact broadens. How many requests affected?

oncall-alex: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical customers for 10m 2) scale tokenizer pool manually 3) roll a targeted config to reduce max batch size on tokenizers 4) enable fallback routing to smaller model for non-slo routes.

eng-ryan: working on batch-size patch now, will push a small change to the sidecar limiter (reduce max_batch_tokens from 4096 -> 2048). Patch ready to apply.

eng-ryan: patch snippet:

```
# sidecar config
max_batch_tokens: 2048
batch_timeout_ms: 6
```

oncall-alex: infra-bot, scaling request to tokenizers pool: +4 replicas now.

infra-bot: Executing: redwoodctl scale pool tokenizers --replicas 8  --region eu-west. Request queued.

oncall-alex: applying throttle rule for non-enterprise customers: client-tier != enterprise -> rate_limit 0.6x.

sre-maya: telemetry note: pushing a temporary kv-cache-warm script to prepopulate top keys to reduce evictions. Command below.

```
curl -X POST http://internal-kv-warm/eu-west/warm -d '{"top_keys": 500}'
```

ops-jordan: status page draft: "We are investigating increased inference latency in EU-west regions. Some requests may experience delays; no errors expected. Updates in 15 minutes." pm-lina: ack, will post if impact persists.

infra-bot: scale request completed: tokenizers pool at 8 replicas.

oncall-alex: @eng-ryan deploy the sidecar limiter patch to canary subset (10% of tokenizers) first.

eng-ryan: canary deployed to 1 pod, monitoring.

sre-maya: seeing initial p99 drop from 6.2s -> 3.8s on canary subset traffic. Good signal.

oncall-alex: rolling to rest of pool gradually. Also enabling fallback route for non-slo endpoints to model-7b-quant for next 30m.

eng-ryan: rolling patch to remainder now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert ack recorded by oncall-alex.

pm-lina: Customers with high SLAs (enterprise) - do we need to notify individually?

oncall-alex: Not yet — only latency, no errors. If p99 stays >3s after 15m we'll escalate to targeted customer comms.

ops-jordan: kv warm script finished, eviction rate down 70% on metric panel.

sre-maya: overall p99 now stabilized ~1.9s across region. Still above 1.5s but trending down.

oncall-alex: keeping the thread open for 30 more mins. If p99 <1.6s and stable for 10m we can resolve. Documenting mitigation steps for postmortem.

pm-lina: noted — will draft a short follow-up with timeline for customers if we close.

eng-ryan: creating follow-up PR with metrics and rationale for permanent batch-limit change.

oncall-alex: thanks team. Quick checklist before resolve: final metrics snapshot, PR link, status page update, postmortem owner. Assigning postmortem to @sre-maya.

sre-maya: taking postmortem. Will collect traces and KV eviction graphs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved by oncall-alex (duration 27m).

oncall-alex: resolving thread — continue async notes in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
